name: Zenithal-Dirge

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: Descendants of a crashed generation ship, their iron-age rites center the hull that never flew again.

description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in tectonic rift valleys. Travelers navigate by towering mountain ranges and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Their beacons answer incoming ships in a hundred borrowed languages.
At the derelict space station in orbit, the toolmarks are still half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
For traders, iron, rare flora and water alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
